tests.name: Globals and opaque handles are shared between blocks before DCL
Ordinary p, div and span targets accept text
HTML characters and Unicode are inserted as plain text
Arguments are strict strings and handles cannot be forged
Code, custom elements, SVG and elements containing children reject writes
DOM strings have a strict 16 KiB UTF-8 boundary
Ordinary Python failures allow the next block to run
Mutation observers run after all Python blocks return
Python mutations and DCL complete before the load event

cases.name: Same-document navigation does not rerun blocks
Different Document globals and modules are isolated
DOM call budget is shared across blocks
